# Discovery brief: Tool library lending desk

mode: greenfield

## Goal
Track which tools a neighbourhood tool library has lent to neighbours and when each one comes back. The user is the volunteer who runs the lending desk on one laptop.

## Capabilities
- Tool catalogue: the list of tools the library holds and can lend.
- Checkout and return log: a record of each tool lent to a neighbour and its return.

## First slice
Record a checkout and its return for a tool that is already in the catalogue.

## Constraints
- Python CLI, as the existing README states.
- Runs offline on one laptop.

## Out of scope
- Online marketplace: no listing or browsing of tools online.
- Payments: no fees, deposits or charges.

## Open questions
- How long should completed checkout records be retained?

# Discovery brief: Street library book loans

mode: greenfield

## Goal
Track books borrowed from a street library, for the volunteers who look after it.

## Capabilities
- Book loan tracking: recording which books are out on loan and when they come back.

## Constraints
- None stated yet. The repository is empty and no platform, language or framework has been chosen.

## Out of scope
- None stated yet.

## Open questions
- Platform and language are undecided.
- The smallest useful first slice is not yet specified.

# Discovery brief: Extra empty rows in CSV export

mode: single-item

## Goal
CSV export inserts an empty row after each record. Remove those empty rows so the export holds only the header and the data rows.

## Item
intent: Remove the extra empty rows from CSV export.
done-signal: Two records export as two data rows under the existing header.
area: Reporting
split-sense: unitary

## Constraints
- Preserve the existing columns and header.
- Follow the existing issue naming in the Reporting workstream.

## Dependencies
- REPORT-17 (correct the CSV parser's row boundaries) must ship first.

## Out of scope
- Report UI redesign: the report screens stay as they are.

# Discovery brief: Import retries and exhaustion notice

mode: single-item

## Goal
Retry imports that fail for transient reasons, and notify operators when the retries are exhausted.

## Item
intent: Retry transient import failures and notify operators after exhaustion.
done-signal: A transient failure retries; exhausted retries produce an operator notification.
area: Data imports
split-sense: possibly-splittable (retry execution and operator notification can be developed independently)

## Constraints
- Use the existing job runner.

## Out of scope
- Replacing the job runner.

## Open questions
- Whether to split retry execution and operator notification into separate pieces of work is left for the methodology to decide.

# Discovery brief: Delivery date on order receipt

mode: single-item

## Goal
Show the scheduled delivery date, already stored on the order, on the order receipt.

## Item
intent: Show the delivery date already stored on the order.
done-signal: A receipt with a stored delivery date shows it; one without it omits the field.
area: Checkout
split-sense: unitary

## Constraints
- Use the existing receipt layout.

## Out of scope
- New delivery estimation logic: the receipt shows the stored date only.

## Open questions
- The display timezone for the delivery date is unresolved; carried forward for /faff-prep.

# Discovery brief: Rehearsal recording organiser

mode: greenfield

## Goal
Let band members organise their rehearsal recordings, which stay on their own machines.

## Capabilities
- Recording catalogue: the list of local rehearsal recordings a band member has added.
- Search by rehearsal date: finding recordings by the date of the rehearsal.

## First slice
List manually selected local recordings by rehearsal date.

## Constraints
- TypeScript, as the repository README specifies and the human confirmed.
- Browser UI, as the repository README specifies and the human confirmed.
- Files remain local.

## Out of scope
- Cloud upload: recordings are never sent off the machine.
- Audio editing: no trimming or changing recordings.

## Open questions
- How should recordings without a date be shown?
